title: Native x64sc Variant Lockstep Tests
condition: Every required x64sc model profile is validated against native x64sc for deterministic startup, BASIC prompt, keyboard input, disk attach/autostart, cartridge boot, and reset scenarios. Validation compares CPU registers, flags, cycle count, selected memory windows, CIA/VIC/SID observable register state, IRQ/NMI state, and frame/raster checkpoints. Missing ROMs, unavailable native x64sc binaries, unsupported variants, skipped variants, or stubbed checks fail the gate.
